english.title: Without reasonable excuse did an act prohibited by a sexual offences prevention order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, did something, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which you were prohibited from doing under the terms of a sexual offences prevention order made by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 113(1)(a) and (2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
